title: Candle. The sheeted mirror. Who brought me into this world lies there, bronzelidded, under few cheap flowers.
html_source:
These sentences are a good example of why critics have chosen internal narrative over stream of consciousness as a diegetic term. The reader is aware the origin of the narrative is Stephen’s thought processes however those thoughts clearly tell a story.

Joyce is telling a story through an effective modernist tool. Stephen continues to struggle with the implications of the death of his mother on his psyche.
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aXGrc-TCHVg

He re-experiences his mother’s death and funeral. ‘The sheeted mirror’ is a wake superstitutuion whereby a sheet is placed over a mirror to prevent the return of the ghost.
